## Description

Employs Matrix Product States (MPS) and quantum tensor network contraction algorithms to solve high-dimensional portfolio optimization problems with complex non-linear entanglement constraints.

## Where it may fit

Large-scale multi-asset allocation with non-convex risk constraints and high combinatorial complexity.

## Vehicles

Institutional quantitative hedge funds, advanced multi-asset allocation desks.

## Required data

Multi-asset historical return covariance tensors, expected returns vector, cardinality constraint limits.

## Caveats

Tensor network bond dimensions must be carefully tuned to balance computational speed and approximation accuracy.
